visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a brown service uniform and tan cap sits on a white toilet in a contemporary bathroom, resting his chin on clasped hands with a thoughtful expression. A freestanding white bathtub and textured gray walls are in the background under soft, warm indoor lighting. Subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The man stands up quickly and balances himself with arms outstretched while sliding his black heavy-duty boots across the floor to test traction. The bathroom features large gray tiles and a wooden vanity. Bright yellow variety text with a glowing effect overlays the middle of the frame to emphasize his actions. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of dark, dirty-looking mosaic tiles, followed by a transition to a factory conveyor belt moving rows of light gray rectangular tiles. The setting is a bright industrial facility with green metal frames. White subtitles and green variety text explain the tile types. (4) A man in a beige shirt stands in a showroom or workshop, holding a large square tile sample with both hands and pointing to its surface. In the background, rows of various tile samples are displayed on racks. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene while bold white text overlays the top. (5) In a manufacturing sequence, a mechanical arm applies droplets of liquid to a tile, followed by a close-up of the tile’s fine sandy texture under bright industrial lights. A computer monitor nearby displays a technical graph showing friction data. Subtitles continue to flow at the bottom center of the frame. (6) Back in the bathroom, the man performs a sliding test with his shoes on the floor to demonstrate the grip of the anti-slip tiles. He then reappears in the showroom holding the tile, speaking directly to the camera with a confident gesture. A final slogan and subscription button appear.
